# Maverick Ayo

> Digital marketing and web design services in Lagos, Nigeria, specializing in responsive design, branding, and SEO optimization.

Maverick Ayo (Awolusi Ayomide) is a freelance digital marketing and web design professional based in Lagos, Nigeria. The site showcases services in website design, graphic design, web development, and branding for clients including GlowSkin and others.
